blocks.text: Podon ki sab se aham khususiyat photosynthesis hai, yani roshni ki energy ko chemical energy mein badal kar apni ghiza khud banana. Yeh amal taqreeban har poday mein hota hai aur khaas organelles, chloroplasts, mein hota hai. Poday ke tamam hare hisson mein, tanay aur kachche phalon samet, chloroplasts hote hain, lekin zyada tar photosynthesis pattiyon (leaves) mein hota hai. Patti ki satah par aam taur par har square millimetre mein taqreeban paanch laakh (half million) chloroplasts hote hain. Chloroplasts mein chlorophyll "a" aur chlorophyll "b" pigments (rang) hain jo photosynthesis ke liye zaroori roshni ki energy jazb karte hain.

Podon aur bohat se protists ke cells mein teen qisam ke plastids hain: chloroplasts, chromoplasts aur leucoplasts. Be-rang leucoplasts cheezen store karte hain aur peele se laal rang wale chromoplasts poday ke hisson ko rang dete hain.
blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)

blocks.text: Ellipsoid (lamba-gol, ande jaisa) chloroplast do membranes mein band hai; dono membranes ke darmiyan ki jagah intermembrane space kehlati hai. Andar wali membrane ke andar ek semi-fluid madda stroma hai. Is mein ghule hue enzymes hain aur chloroplast ka zyada tar hajam yahi hai. Bahar wali membrane andar wali se kahin zyada permeable hai.

Andar ki membranes ek doosre ke bohat qareeb hoti hain aur kinaron par jur jati hain. Is tarah do saath wali membranes mil kar ek disk (tikki) jaisa khana banati hain jise thylakoid kehte hain. Bohat se thylakoids ke dher (stacks) grana (wahid: granum) kehlate hain. Lamellae woh ghair-hare hisse hain jo do grana ko jorte hain. Har granum mein chand se le kar kai thylakoids ho sakte hain, aur ek chloroplast mein sau ya zyada grana. Mitochondrion ki tarah chloroplast bhi doosre organelles se mukhtalif hai, kyun ke is ka apna DNA hai aur yeh cell se alag khud reproduce karta hai.

Mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein mushabihat (similarity) hai. Dono cell ke liye energy ko ek shakal se doosri mein badalte hain. Mitochondria aerobic respiration karte hain: oxygen ki madad se sugars, fats aur doosre chemical fuels ko tor kar ATP ki shakal mein chemical energy banate hain. Chloroplasts photosynthesis karte hain: sooraj ki energy se carbon dioxide aur pani istemal kar ke organic nutrients banate hain. Mitochondria ki tarah chloroplasts ka bhi apna DNA hai aur yeh cell se alag barh aur reproduce ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Chloroplast ki lambi qash: outer membrane aur inner membrane stroma ko gherti hain. Andar disc jaise thylakoids ke dher grana banate hain; har thylakoid ke andar lumen hai, aur chapti stroma lamellae ek granum ko doosre se jorti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Thylakoid ki membrane mein chlorophyll hai jahan roshni pakri jati hai; thylakoid ke andar ki jagah lumen hai. Stroma thylakoids ke bahar ka maada hai jahan glucose banta hai. Chloroplast mein apna circular DNA aur ribosomes bhi hote hain, magar woh is figure mein label nahin.

Roshni thylakoid disks mein jure chlorophyll molecules jazb karte hain. Roshni jazb kar ke yeh chlorophyll molecules electrons chhorte hain, aur is tarah ATP banta hai. Phir stroma mein in ATP ki madad se kam energy wali carbon dioxide ko zyada energy wale compound, jaise glucose, mein badla jata hai.
